author: Emmaye
body: Oh man, I can't believe I did it, I made it to my goal to successfully reach 100,000 kills on The Avicus Network. I've had some fun times and joyful moments for this past year. There is so many people I helped me with my problems I have ran into through the months of 2014, but two people that stood out to me was glitchy1 and RefuseToSink. You two people are very kind people, always there for someone, and it makes me feel grateful to know you overall, thank you so much. This server has such a wonderful community and staff team. Here is to another great year for The Avicus Network! Here's the 100,000 kill video if you wanted to see this - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5zEgh9M-fP4
